## Summary of the Feature
A clear and concise description of the feature or capability you would like to see added.

## Motivation & Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a specific problem or workflow friction? Please describe.

## Proposed Solution / Design
Describe the solution or design you would prefer to see implemented:
- Which agent or tool would handle this?
- How should the CLI or GitHub workflow interface with it?

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, diagrams, or mock outputs about the feature request here.
